remarks: Located at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in Darien, this updated 5-bedroom Colonial combines space, comfort, and convenience. The main level features a newly renovated eat-in kitchen with modern finishes and ample space for everyday living and casual entertaining. Upstairs, there are five bedrooms, including a primary suite with an updated bath and a full wall of custom closets with sleek sliding doors. The walk-out basement adds flexibility, complete with a wine cellar and additional space ideal for a rec room, gym, or private in-law suite. Outdoor spaces are equally inviting, with a deck just off the kitchen for outdoor dining and a backyard fire pit for relaxed evenings. Conveniently located within walking distance to downtown, Metro-North, Royle Elementary School, and Tilley Pond Park, this home offers a quiet setting with easy access to everything Darien has to offer. A rare rental opportunity that truly feels like home!
